en.title: 2D physics: joints, ropes, and bodies that change kind
en.body: From the notes of Mechanism City, a physics puzzle game. The 2D physics world has joints: `world.addJoint({ kind: 'distance' | 'rope', a, b })` holds two bodies at a length, as a rod, or no further apart than it, as a rope; with `point` it holds a body to a place in the world, and a distance of 0 is a pin, for pendulums and hanging weights. A rope's `length` can be wound in, `removeJoint` cuts it, and anchors can sit away from a body's centre. `body.setKind('dynamic')` lets a held body fall where it is, keeping its contacts, joints and data, instead of being removed and made again. The documentation now says what a contact listener may do: change the world for the next step, but not call `step`, which is refused with `PHYSICS_STEP_REENTRANT`. Bodies still do not turn by themselves, so there is no hinge that tips a plank.

zh.title: 2D 物理：关节、绳子，以及可以切换种类的刚体
zh.body: 来自物理解谜游戏《千机巧匠》的笔记。2D 物理世界有了关节：`world.addJoint({ kind: 'distance' | 'rope', a, b })` 让两个刚体保持一个长度（像杆），或不超过这个长度（像绳）；用 `point` 可以把刚体拴在世界中的一个点上，长度为 0 就是钉子，用来做单摆和吊着的重物。绳子的 `length` 可以收放，`removeJoint` 剪断，锚点可以离开刚体中心。`body.setKind('dynamic')` 让被托住的刚体原地开始下落，保留接触、关节和数据，不必删掉重建。文档写明了接触监听器里能做什么：可以改动世界（下一步生效），但不能调用 `step`，否则以 `PHYSICS_STEP_REENTRANT` 拒绝。刚体仍然不会自己转动，所以还没有能让木板倾斜的铰链。
